## Verification evidence

- Exact revision and platform tested:
- Commands and outcomes:
- Unavailable checks and remaining limitations:

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the checks appropriate to your change.
For behavior changes, describe the failing test before the fix and the passing
result afterward. For tool or image changes, include archive verification and
native AMD64/ARM64 smoke evidence; identify any pending coverage.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Each commit is one focused Conventional Commit with a body explaining why.
- [ ] Documentation, licenses, and upstream notices match the change.
- [ ] Reports and fixtures contain no credentials or private configuration.
- [ ] Remaining upstream findings and release blockers are stated explicitly.
